page.overview:
Who is Nezaral?

Nezaral is a fictional character from Marvel Comics created in 1995 by Ian Edginton. It first appeared in issue #8 of the 1st volume of Blade: The Vampire-Hunter comic book series.

Nezaral is a demon who is an agent of the Elder God Chthon. It is a giant demon able to swallow a human whole. The demon is immortal, possesses an endless hunger for souls, has superhuman strength, and is able to empower others with demonic abilities.

Category:Other Supernatural Beings Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
